title: Square Divisors of a Million
statement: How many positive divisors of $1{,}000{,}000$ are perfect squares?
insight: A divisor 2^a·5^b of 2^6·5^6 is a square iff a and b are both even: 4 choices each.
redHerring: Listing divisors and checking each one.
solution: $10^6 = 2^6 5^6$. A divisor $2^a5^b$ is a square iff $a, b$ are even, so $a,b\in\{0,2,4,6\}$. That gives $4\times4 = 16$.
